title: Hydration Monitoring Using Urinary Biomarkers: A Hybrid Classical Quantum Predictive Modeling Framework
summary: Hydration status is a key physiological indicator associated with cellular homeostasis, renal function, and overall health. Recent advances in smart sensing environments enable passive monitoring of urinary biomarkers that can provide continuous insight into hydration dynamics. In this work, we investigate predictive modeling approaches for hydration monitoring using biomarker data collected through the Predict Health Toilet (PHT) system.
